title: perfect!
body:
This is such a user-friendly, and all in all friendly, app! 

It's simple and straight to the point, there's instructions...
During the first seven days, you'll be receiving (encouraging) emails, I loved that! 
You can turn them off if you don't like it though, which I think is another great point.

If you don't get the premium version, you can only track 3 habits at a time, but it is enough to get started and once you've created a habit out of something, you don't need to track it anymore, so you can switch it to something else/new!

The developers did a fantastic job.
